assumptions: Delivery preflight review enforcement is opt-in on --assign-reviewer in this PR; making it mandatory is a later programme step.
The pass-2 rebuild and the sidecar registry are out of scope.
goal: Wire delivery preflight into the lane manager with invalidation-gated reuse, and carry review approval across evidence-only commits, verified stored script-hash re-pins and diff-identical main merges, recording the approved implementation digest.
prohibited_actions: No database, migration, claim, preview, production, marker or infrastructure mutation.
Do not edit orchestrator-snapshot, start-reroute or migration-train scripts.
Do not draw reviewers or merge.
stop_conditions: Stop once the PR is open with a validated evidence pair and CI running.
Stop on any required check failure or lane refusal.
